pick.name: Readwise Reader
pick.what: Reader for articles, PDFs, newsletters, RSS with highlight export and hosted MCP/API
pick.why: Best-in-class reader with highlights that flow into notes and agents
pick.free_limits: 30-day trial; Reader-only $7.99/mo annual, Full $9.99/mo annual; 50% student discount
pick.maintained: SaaS; old readwise-mcp repo deprecated 2026-03 for hosted MCP

best_free.name: Instapaper
best_free.what: Read-later app with extension, web and mobile apps
best_free.why: Survivor of the 2024-25 shutdowns with unlimited free saves
best_free.free_limits: Free: unlimited saves, folders, API, 5 notes/month; Premium $5.99/mo or $59.99/yr

alts.name: Karakeep (ex-Hoarder)
alts.what: Self-hosted bookmark/read-later with AI tagging and highlights
alts.why: Best open-source option if you self-host
alts.free_limits: Self-host free; Karakeep Cloud price not checked

alts.name: Raindrop.io
alts.free_limits: Free: unlimited bookmarks/highlights/devices; Pro adds full-text search, permanent copies, AI, MCP

candidates.name: Karakeep
candidates.verdict: Open source, needs server, AGPL (fine for self-use)

decision: Readwise Reader is the best reading tool: highlights, PDFs, newsletters and an MCP for agents. Instapaper Free is enough for save-and-read. Never adopt a tool without an export path; Pocket and Omnivore both shut down.

verify.note: Verified: Full $9.99/mo, Reader-only $7.99/mo (annual), 30-day trial, 50% academic discount.
